message.content:
Work in /opt/nxeon (Next.js/TS, live prod tree). You OWN the ADMIN email/mail dashboard page and its components ONLY. Do NOT touch the sidebar/topbar/widgets (another agent owns chrome), the customer webmail, or lib/mailer.

Board card cmst1v0tr "Fix email dashboard on admin portal": two bugs —
1. The admin email dashboard is **running off the screen at the bottom** (layout/overflow bug) — fix the layout so it fits/scrolls correctly within the admin content area.
2. The **default company mailbox** (e.g. the shared admin/support mailbox that works on the customer/dashboard side) **isn't working on the admin side** — admins can't read it. Diagnose why the admin mail view fails to load the default mailbox and fix it so the admin can read that mailbox.

A screenshot may be at /opt/nxeon/board-uploads/board/cmst1v0tr00bphlxvymd44xh7/ — read it with the Read tool. Start by finding the admin mail page (likely under app/admin/mail or app/admin/email) and how it resolves/loads the mailbox (compare to the working customer path lib/mail/* + CompanyMailbox model). The mail backend is Mailcow over IMAP (MAIL_IMAP_HOST 10.20.0.10).

Constraints: do NOT run `npm run build`/`next build` — verify with `npx tsc --noEmit` only. Report: root cause of the mailbox failure, files changed, tsc result.

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them.
